$comment: DOCUMENTATION, NOT CONFIGURATION. Railway rejects a railway.json config-as-code path as
deprecated (RUNBOOK, immediately-owed item 2), so nothing reads this file: it records the
settings the coordinator applies by hand when creating the `plantgeo-ml-cron` service, so the
intended shape is reviewable in the tree instead of living only in a dashboard.
The service is created by the coordinator and its schedule is NEVER armed without an owner go
(spec FR-10). An unarmed service that exists is harmless; an armed one writes to the lanes.
06:30 UTC: after every upstream lane's own daily publication window and before the web's
morning traffic. No healthcheck and no domain: a cron service has no port to probe, and a
generated domain would make a one-shot turn look like a service that is down between runs.
ON_FAILURE, not ALWAYS: a bounded turn exits 0 and must not be restarted, and a turn that
exited 4 could not reach the bucket, which is worth one retry.
Reference variables from `plantgeo-parquet-api`, exactly as `plantgeo-ml` carries them, so
the two services read one bucket with one set of credentials. NO variable whose name
contains DATABASE_URL, DATABASE_DSN, POSTGRES_DSN, PGHOST or PGDATABASE may be set here:
`config.Settings` refuses to construct while one is present (decision D5).
